publication: Working tree only; no commit, push, package release or Stage 07 implementation

resolvedFindings.title: Early exits lose settled results before context batching commits
Receipt-only authentic delivery removes failed-result protection
Recovery between checkpoint and restore creates duplicate final results

compatibility.newAPIs: None; settlement callbacks, result-bearing provenance and restore reconciliation are private implementation details.
compatibility.rawReturnsEvents: Preserved; no additional tool/model call or replay of external action.
compatibility.partialBatches: Managed run failure and stream closure retain completed unacknowledged observations and associated assistant/provider state. External transport history remains host-owned; explicit context destruction remains host authority.
compatibility.receiptOnly: Authentic record without a result body stays a stored execution diagnostic but cannot release raw context protection or authorize async continuation. Real redacted/null result bodies may be acknowledged. Optional outcomes and legacy outcome-only metadata remain supported.
compatibility.snapshots: Loaded checkpoint owns matching namespace/call/execution identities across receipt changes. Unrelated pending content and separate invocations remain. Legacy metadata without execution IDs retains exact-copy fallback. Older failed checkpoints can require acknowledgement again.

coverage.limitation: Scoped percentages exclude Agent/context; their integration is covered by unit/live cases.

live.credentialSource: .env via named connectors; values are not recorded
live.scope: Functional exact retrieval/raw-fallback/recovery probes with synthetic local tools. New per-provider stream-close probes retain failed-storage observations, save/load and acknowledge recovery, then read exact markers with two model calls and one original tool action. No external write or statistical reliability estimate claimed.
live.command: RUN_AGENTIC_BASELINE_LIVE=1 RUN_CONTEXT_FRESHNESS_LIVE=1 RUN_TOOL_OUTCOMES_LIVE=1 RUN_MODEL_EXECUTION_LIVE=1 RUN_EVIDENCE_LIVE=1 npx vitest run tests/integration/text/{AgenticBaseline,ContextFreshness,ToolOutcomes,ModelExecution,Evidence}.live.integration.test.ts
